intent: A gothic parish court gown in black wool with one large leaded lancet of crimson, violet and amber on the bodice, a crimson waist and a two-tier skirt ending in a stained-glass hem border, under a thin steeple coif and long veil; from the high camera it reads as a narrow crimson waist over a wide two-tier bell, with the glass gathered into one panel and one hem ring.
requests: A glass material that keeps a pane's colour and stays opaque under the mood preset; SmoothPlastic was the closest.
A tapered or trapezoid panel, so a skirt can flare along its length instead of stepping in boxes.
